observations: Collaborators title for an agent with no registry entry comes from delivery.ResolveSessionTitles, the shared helper: the newest event's origin title. When that newest event carries none (tst-agent's last writes had no origin) the row's title is null, although an older event of the session carried 'Legion tester · TST-1'. The field comment says 'the session's newest stamped title'. Plugin writes always stamp a title, so this shows only for writes made without one; no criterion names the title.
Every holder of the listener's API bearer can write the registry, as every other /v1 write; 'the daemon is the only writer' is a convention, not an enforced boundary.
A registry entry's live flag follows the session registry's 5-minute TTL: a subscribed session read false until it renewed its subscription.
